Native movie_decode.c uses internal baseline JPEG YCbCr planes from this exact pinned snapshot (no RGB conversion). Replacements require rerunning native decoder tests because these are internal interfaces. STBI_ONLY_JPEG, STBI_NO_STDIO, STBI_NO_SIMD and STBI_MAX_DIMENSIONS=640 are local compile definitions, not vendor edits.
